result.detail: Sentry public integrations (OAuth) start unpublished. Unpublished = only creator org can see/install. Other orgs need integration published, which means submit via "Publish" and Sentry approval. No install cap stated. Workaround per notes: per-customer auth tokens (user auth tokens / internal integration tokens each customer creates) are no gate, but that is not an OAuth app.
result.quote: If your integration is still in an unpublished state, the only Sentry organization that will be able to see or install it will be the organization that created the integration.
